item.title: 13 Seconds of Your Voice Is All It Takes, with Amar Chheda | ML Engineer @ GetReal
item.itunes:title: 13 Seconds of Your Voice Is All It Takes, with Amar Chheda | ML Engineer @ GetReal
item.description:
Watch this episode on YouTube!

Amar Chheda told me "It doesn't need more than 10 to 13 seconds of voice either to clone your exact voice." Then I shared my screen and played him something ChatGPT did when I asked it to set up a direct mail testing page on my website. Without me asking, it cloned my voice and made a video of me doing the voiceover.

Amar is a machine learning engineer at GetReal, a cybersecurity company that verifies people are who they say they are on calls. We talk about deepfake hiring fraud, like bait and switch interviews and North Korean operatives trying to get hired at American companies. We also get into why bot traffic isn't automatically junk anymore, why watermarks like C2PA and SynthID can get lost when a video moves from Instagram to WhatsApp, and what marketers should think about before using AI avatars in their content.

item.itunes:title: The Best Attribution Model is the One People Understand, with Barbara Galiza | Sponsored by ASofronas Marketing Services
item.description:
Sponsored by ASofronas Marketing Services

Watch this episode on YouTube!

I sat down with Barbara Galiza, co-founder of Propel, to unpack why marketing attribution is broken, and what to do about it. We dig into why MMM has a monopoly on budget decisions, why direct mail keeps getting undervalued, and how out-of-box attribution tools miss the context that actually drives business outcomes. Along the way: a matchback brain teaser involving apartment numbers, why attribution is really just politics, how Apple's ATT changes destroyed mobile measurement, and whether we should flip the data ecosystem so consumers hold the power. If you've ever fought to prove a channel's worth, this one's for you.
